versions.changelog:
Initial release: Integrate any OpenAI-compatible LLM API into Hermes Agent as a custom provider.

- Supports endpoints implementing /v1/chat/completions (e.g. Cloudflare Workers AI, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, and others).
- Host-gated OpenAI API key usage for enhanced security; non-OpenAI endpoints require API key in config.yaml.
- Inline or named provider setup in Hermes config for flexible multi-endpoint management.
- Covers context length setting, model switching, and best practices for probing/validating endpoint/model compatibility.
- Detailed caveats, validation guidance, and migration tips included for robust provider integration.
